items.headline: Asian shares are mixed as tech stocks remain volatile and oil falls
items.summary: Asian technology stocks remained volatile amid growing concerns about the sustainability of the AI boom. South Korea's Kospi rose 1.8% after a sharp prior-week decline; Samsung Electronics gained 1.2% and SK Hynix 0.4%. Japan's Nikkei fell 0.6%, Tokyo Electron declined 2.6%, and SoftBank Group fell 2%. Investors were also focused on upcoming earnings from major U.S. companies including Meta, Netflix, Tesla and IBM.
